title.zh: Node2Shell evolves to HTTP2Shell, blast radius affects many HTTP libs and apps
title.en: Node2Shell evolves to HTTP2Shell, blast radius affects many HTTP libs and apps

current_state.zh: The Node2Shell vulnerability has evolved into HTTP2Shell, tracked as Brotli CVE-2026-111497, an unauthenticated remote code execution issue in Brotli decoding that affects many Python HTTP libraries and applications and is now driving patching and deployment checks.
current_state.en: The Node2Shell vulnerability has evolved into HTTP2Shell, tracked as Brotli CVE-2026-111497, an unauthenticated remote code execution issue in Brotli decoding that affects many Python HTTP libraries and applications and is now driving patching and deployment checks.
